blocks.text: Oxford Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

24 houses sold in Oxford Heights with a median price of $1,269,000 (the middle half sold between $1,126,250 and $1,399,250), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $590 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 6,639 square feet.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses and 2 condos and townhomes listed in Oxford Heights. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Oxford Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 23% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Oxford Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 13 houses and 1 condos and townhomes sold in Oxford Heights over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in September with 5 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Oxford Heights compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, Oxford Heights held 9.5% of the 137 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 0.9% of the 219 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 86.7% of the 15 homes listed in Oxford Heights and condos and townhomes made up 13.3%; of the 3 that sold, houses were 100.0% and condos and townhomes 0.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Oxford Heights than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 19 in June to 13 in October 2026 (−31.6%); condos and townhomes was 1 in June and 2 in October 2026, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall.

faq.q: What did houses in Oxford Heights sell for?
faq.a: 24 houses sold in Oxford Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,269,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.4% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
